places.name: Acadia National Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning national park featuring rugged coastlines, forests, and the iconic Cadillac Mountain.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor centers have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Drive the Park Loop Road for the best views and visit Jordan Pond House for popovers.

places.name: Portland Head Light
places.ai_summary: A historic lighthouse offering breathtaking views of the Maine coastline.

opening_hours.notes: Grounds are open year-round. Museum hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views of the lighthouse and ocean.

places.name: Cadillac Mountain
places.ai_summary: The highest point on the U.S. East Coast, offering panoramic views and stunning sunrises.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be limited during winter.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to catch the sunrise, as it’s one of the first places to see it in the U.S.

opening_hours.notes: Many shops and galleries have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the local shops, galleries, and restaurants. Don’t miss the street performances in the summer.

opening_hours.notes: Best walked at low tide for beach access.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and be prepared for variable weather. The path can be rocky.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful botanical garden in Boothbay, featuring a diverse collection of plants and stunning waterfront views.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the events calendar for workshops and special events. The garden is large, plan your visit accordingly.

places.name: Mount Desert Island
places.ai_summary: An island in Maine's Frenchman Bay, known for its stunning natural beauty and outdoor recreational opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Acadia National Park hours apply.

places.place_tip: Explore the island by car, bike, or on foot. Don’t miss the scenic drives and hiking trails.

places.name: Pemaquid Point Light
places.ai_summary: A picturesque lighthouse located on the Pemaquid Point, known for its stunning views and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: The lighthouse is open for tours during the summer months.

places.place_tip: Visit the Pemaquid Beach nearby for a complete experience. The area is great for photography, especially at sunrise and sunset.

places.name: Kennebunkport
places.ai_summary: A charming town known for its beautiful beaches, quaint shops, and the Bush family compound.

opening_hours.notes: Many shops close early, especially in the off-season.

places.place_tip: Explore the beaches and take a boat tour to see the coastal wildlife. Visit the Kennebunkport Historical Society for a dose of local history.

places.name: Boothbay Harbor
places.ai_summary: A picturesque harbor town known for its boating, fishing, and scenic beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited by boat or ferry for the full experience.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore the harbor and nearby islands. Visit the Coastal Maine Botanical Gardens located a short drive away.

opening_hours.notes: Acadia National Park hours apply.

places.place_tip: Explore the town’s shops and restaurants, and take advantage of the outdoor activities in the area.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful sandy beach in Ogunquit, popular for sunbathing, swimming, and beachcombing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at low tide for beachcombing.

places.place_tip: Check the tide schedules for the best beachcombing opportunities. The beach is family-friendly with nearby amenities.

places.name: Farnsworth Art Museum
places.ai_summary: An art museum in Rockland, showcasing American art with a focus on Maine artists.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major holidays.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique art-inspired gifts. The museum often hosts special exhibitions and events.
places.address: Farnsworth Art Museum, Rockland, Maine, USA

places.name: Baxter State Park
places.ai_summary: A large wilderness area in Maine, offering a range of outdoor activities and home to Mount Katahdin.

opening_hours.notes: Campground reservations required in advance.

places.place_tip: Plan your visit to include a hike up Mount Katahdin, the views from the top are breathtaking. Check for moose in the park, especially at dawn and dusk.

places.name: Mount Katahdin
places.ai_summary: The highest mountain in Maine, offering challenging hikes and stunning views from the summit.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted in winter.

places.place_tip: Start your hike early to avoid afternoon storms and to enjoy the summit views with fewer people. The Knife Edge trail is for experienced hikers only.
places.address: Mount Katahdin, Baxter State Park, Maine, USA

places.name: Old Orchard Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach destination in Maine, known for its long sandy beach and vibrant boardwalk.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the summer months.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the beach activities and take a stroll on the boardwalk. Try the local seafood at nearby restaurants.

places.ai_summary: A remote island off the coast of Maine, known for its stunning natural beauty and artist community.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedules vary, check in advance.

places.place_tip: Explore the island’s trails and visit the artist studios. The island is a birdwatcher’s paradise, especially during migration seasons.

places.ai_summary: The largest lake in Maine, offering a variety of recreational activities and stunning natural scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Best accessed by car. Check local guides for activity availability.

places.place_tip: Enjoy boating, fishing, and hiking in the surrounding areas. The lake is known for its moose sightings, especially at dawn and dusk.
